title: Inter: 14 claims in the Italian press this week — only one confirmed | Sunday scorecard
description:
Inter's papers printed 14 claims this week. The club confirmed one.
https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?ed=26

Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.

DENIED — L'Équipe (Sep 24): Zidane would start Andy Diouf at left back. Inter.it (Sep 26) has him an unused substitute in France's 1–0 win in Turkey.
CONFIRMED — FCInterNews (Sep 20): thirteen Inter players away with their countries. Inter.it said the same on Sep 23.
STILL OPEN — Gazzetta dello Sport (Sep 22) and Corriere dello Sport (Sep 25): Djed Spence back in full training. No word from the club, and no minutes this season.
OUR TALLY — 14 reported claims across editions 20–26: one confirmed, one denied, twelve still open.

Read today's edition: https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/p/edition-26/
